sources.snippet: Krea 2 Turbo is Krea AI's flagship open-weight text-to-image diffusion model optimized for fast, high-quality image generation. Built on a 12-billion-parameter Diffusion Transformer (DiT), it is a distilled and post-trained version of the Krea 2 Raw checkpoint, enabling photorealistic and artistic image synthesis in as few as eight inference steps.
